text: Nice, laidback yet professional setup with fully equipped facilities for padel games and coaching. The reception is a nice spot to sit and relax before and after games but doesn't accommodate large number of guests.

Absolutely loved our time at Bantai Padel. The facilities are top tier, beautifully maintained, and genuinely some of the best we’ve played on. Everything feels considered, from the courts to the overall setup.

The service is exceptional. Huge shoutout to the entire team, especially Browny, Stefano, and Pie, who make the place feel welcoming, fun, and effortless from the moment you arrive.

Special mention to Marco for the padel lessons. Clear, patient, and next level coaching. Whether you’re new or experienced, the sessions are incredibly valuable and enjoyable.

And the pool… easily one of the best parts. Nothing beats jumping in for a swim after a solid game of padel. Such a perfect way to recover and reset.

An unreal spot with an amazing team. Highly recommend to anyone visiting or living nearby.

I joined the padel camp  and had a great time. The coach is very good, patient, and explains everything clearly. The owner is super friendly and makes you feel welcome from the first moment. The atmosphere is relaxed,, and the courts are in good condition. I improved my game and enjoyed every session. Highly recommended
